== Overview ==

Client Patch 2.2.5 Changelog Beginner’s Wings added for level 100, obtainable through the Dawnport Quest.. New temporary special wings available in the Market Points shop.. Updated sprites for all existing wings.. Companion food is now saved even after dismissing your companion.. A new food status icon will appear when your companion is regenerating from food while summoned.. Fixed a server crash related to Onlook’s loot list.. These changes will take effect after a server restart.. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.
